comparison.objective: Exchange collection bins under a running chute between timed part drops.
comparison.physical_skill: Time grasping and transport of loaded and empty bins while continuously catching discrete falling parts.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly six parts in the first bin, later parts in the second, both bins placed correctly, and no missed or lost part.
comparison.reason: Both involve collection containers, but this task tests timed bin exchange under an intermittent stream, not separating a mixed batch by aperture and agitation.
